# Keyboard shortcuts

These are the default keys. Change any of them in Settings → Keyboard (Help → Keyboard shortcuts), or in the user `Config.xml`, see [Settings](features/settings.md#keyboard).
Commands without a key run from the [command palette](features/palette.md) (Ctrl+K, ⌘K on macOS).

## Navigation

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| Open folder | Enter | ↵ |
| Parent folder | Backspace, Escape | ⌫, Esc |
| Root folder | Home | Home |
| Back | Alt+Left | ⌥← |
| Forward | Alt+Right | ⌥→ |
| Go to folder… (type a path) | Ctrl+L | ⌘L, ⌃L |
| Choose folder… | — | — |
| History… | — | — |
| Bookmarks… | — | — |
| Add bookmark | Ctrl+D | ⌘D, ⌃D |
| Folder tree… | Ctrl+Shift+T | ⇧⌘T, ⌃⇧T |

## Selection

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| Mark / unmark file | Space, Insert, S | Space, Insert, S |
| Mark all | Ctrl+A, A | ⌘A, ⌃A, A |
| Invert marks | R | R |
| Mark same type | T | T |
| Copy paths to clipboard | Ctrl+C | ⌘C, ⌃C |
| Paste files | Ctrl+V | ⌘V, ⌃V |

## File operations

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| View / open with default app | F3, E | F3, E |
| Edit | F4, N | F4, N |
| New file | Shift+F4 | ⇧F4 |
| Copy to other pane | F5, C | F5, C |
| Copy within this pane | Shift+F5 | ⇧F5 |
| Rename | Shift+F6, F2 | ⇧F6, F2 |
| Move to other pane | F6, M | F6, M |
| New folder | F7, F1 | F7, F1 |
| Delete (to Trash) | F8, Delete | F8, Delete |
| Delete permanently | Shift+F8, Shift+Delete | ⇧F8, ⇧Delete |
| Terminal here | F9, Shift+C | F9, ⇧C |
| Zip… | Ctrl+Z | ⌘Z, ⌃Z |
| Unzip… | Ctrl+U | ⌘U, ⌃U |
| Properties | Ctrl+I | ⌘I, ⌃I |
| Run as administrator | Ctrl+E | ⌘E, ⌃E |
| Refresh | Ctrl+R | ⌘R, ⌃R |
| Show / hide hidden files | Ctrl+H | ⌃H |
| Details / thumbnail view | — | — |

| Same folder in other pane | — | — |
